description:
The Vamoose MATADOR is built to crush descents and conquer climbs with a RockShox suspension setup, 4-piston hydraulic brakes, and a powerful BAFANG M430 mid-drive motor, with 140Nm of torque. Ride harder, stop faster, and take on any trail.DOMINATE THE DESCENTEngineered for riders who crave control, power, and confidence, the Vamoose MATADOR is your all-terrain powerhouse. Up front, the RockShox 35G Air Fork R delivers 160mm of plush travel, while a RockShox Deluxe rear shock with lock-out smooths out the toughest trails. Need stopping power? The Tektro HD390 4-piston hydraulic brakes have you covered. And when the climb gets steep or the trail demands more, the BAFANG M430 48V 500W mid-drive motor kicks in with responsive, pedal-synced torque that keeps you charging forward - and a THROTTLE when you want it! Whether you're ripping down mountain tracks or grinding out technical climbs, the MATADOR delivers power when you want it, and control when you need it.This cycle comes standard with the following adders:

• BAFANG M430 48v 500w mid drive motor, with 140Nm of torque

• UL Certified 48v 15ah Samsung with 5000mah cells

• A 6061 aircraft aluminum frame with a Rockshox Domain R Air Fork with thru axle

• Torque sensor

• Hydraulic Tektro HD3940 hydraulic quad piston brakes

• Front MAXXIS Recon 29*2.8" and Rear MAXXIS Recon 27.5x2.8" tires

• MAXXIS™ Minion tires

• Dropper seat post (170mm)

• Thumb Throttle
